metadata.title: पेसा1996 पर विक्टर मालतो क्या चाहते हैं | Victor Malto on PESA Implementation in Jharkhand
metadata.description:
Victor Malto, National Convener of the Adivasi Budhijivi Manch and a prominent tribal rights activist, has been at the forefront of the movement demanding the implementation of the Panchayats (Extension to Scheduled Areas) Act, 1996 (PESA) in Jharkhand.

He recently participated in the state government's workshop on the draft PESA rules, held in Ranchi on 15 May 2025. After the event, he spoke exclusively to Main Bhi Bharat's Editor, Shyam Sunder. In this insightful conversation, Malto emphasized his commitment to constructive dialogue, stating, "I want to be part of the solution, not the problem."

Watch the full interview to understand why PESA matters to tribal communities and what steps activists like Victor Malto believe are necessary for meaningful implementation.
